name: Vegan Gluten-Free Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350° F and line a baking pan with parchment paper, preferably 8 x 8 in
In a large bowl mix melted butter and sugar until well combined. Then, stir in maple syrup and soy milk
Add in flour, sifted cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. Whisk until well combined, mixture should be thick
Fold in chocolate chips and dump batter into the pan. Smooth out the top with a spatula or hands
Bake for 30 min, the middle still should be a little jiggly
Remove and let the brownies cool for 15 minutes in the pan.
Remove brownies from pan and cool for another 30 minutes. Enjoy!
